correctness.rationale: The 8 halfspaces define exactly the 12 listed truncated-tetrahedron vertices; independent rational Cramer enumeration establishes that none are missing. Exactly 18 edges follow from facet incidences. All 220 triple determinants of vertex normals are nonzero, giving 134 spherical chambers and exactly 132 arrangement vertices. Integer sign enumeration covers four sectors at every crossing, reproduces 30/72/32 chambers by section type and the full corner-angle table. Spherical excess yields all three exact probabilities. The expected number of section vertices independently equals \(18\arccos(7/11)/\pi\) by edge separation probabilities. Numerical simulation is ancillary and is not used to prove the result.

value.rationale: The full distribution of section combinatorial types is a natural exact invariant in stochastic polyhedral stereology for a classical non-centrally-symmetric Archimedean solid. It is not implied by the one-line Crofton formula for the expectation, because that first moment does not determine its three probabilities. The explicit nonzero odd-section probability and the 134-chamber exact derivation answer the complete finite natural distribution problem, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Reproducibility and precision support correctness but are not the sole basis of value.
